author: The Babylon Bee
description: A millennial caller admitted to Dave Ramsey that he has purchased The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time on at least 7 different occasions and will need advice on buying the new version on Switch 2 even though it is not in his budget.
title: Dave Ramsey Appalled As Caller Admits He's Paid Full Price For 'Ocarina Of Time' At Least 7 Times
